notes.title: Big Thank You for 70k Wishlists! & Extended Wanderburg Trailer
notes.notes:
[p]Hey everyone, 
[/p][p]We wanted to [b]thank you for all of the support and attention you've given Wanderburg[/b] so far! We couldn't have imagined a better reception and are super hyped and grateful to all of you.[/p][p]
It's absolutely mind blowing to us that [b]over 70k of you have wishlisted Wanderburg in just 1.5 months![/b][/p][p]And as many of you know, [b]wishlisting and following is super important[/b] for us indie devs, as it helps us get noticed by the Steam Algorithm. Therefore a Big Thank You from us three! [/p][p][/p][p]If you haven't wishlisted Wanderburg yet, you can do it here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3624140/Wanderburg/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]As a small goodie, check out our new [b]Extended Wanderburg Trailer[/b] that we made for the [url="https://store.steampowered.com/sale/Games-Forged-in-Germany"]Games Forged in Germany Showcase[/url]!   [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/cCy7n5mKJaE"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Can't wait to share more of Wanderburg with you and please [b][url="https://discord.gg/KKjWpyttsK" style="button" buttoncolor="#5865f2"]Join our Discord[/url][/b] to stay up to date with everything around Wanderburg![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p]Lastly we wanted to give a shout out to three games from friends: [/p][p][b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1737870/REKA/"]REKA[/url][/b], an atmospheric witchcraft adventure in which you control, similar to Wanderburg, a moving hut![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/1737870/REKA/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/"][b]Star Birds[/b][/url], a relaxing asteroid base-building and resource management game made by the developers of Dorformantik! (Demo available on their Steam Page)[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2719750/Star_Birds/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3631290"][b]Slots & Daggers[/b][/url] is a newly announced retro-fantasy roguelike where battles are waged on a slot machine. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3631290/Slots__Daggers/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]Randwerk[/p][p]
[/p]
